title: T-shirts — Shield format for sub-programs, clubs or teams
slide_intent: Teach designers to fit a local club identity into a crest that a spectator can read alongside the player number.
strategic_value: Clubs can use a locally meaningful animal, monogram or number within a bounded shape while retaining the program affiliation on team uniforms.
demonstration: A numbered shirt shows a small shield. Larger diagrams compare two-color and single-color shields. A vertical set demonstrates an animal, a letter and an area number.
practical_value: Choose a shield motif from the team name or location and test it in one color. The guide recommends about 100 mm height and limits these identities to team shirts or uniforms.

content_islands.spec: Set the shirt-only scope and numbered notes in the left column.

content_islands.name: Crest placement and variants
content_islands.spec: Pair the shirt with enlarged two-color and single-color versions of the same shield. Show its size relative to the number.

content_islands.spec: Stack three shields on the right. Compare the pictorial, monogram and area-number approaches within the same outline.
